description_en: Queries the list of intelligent alert events for an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询IPC设备的智能告警事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-device-event --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id zLZyi6aOLyOSHa9hsPyD000000 --event-type 0 --begin-time 1539507310000 --end-time 1539607310000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceEvent

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html on IoT Platform to query this ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier for the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of intelligent alert event:
Set to all intelligent alert events: 0.
Set to a specific intelligent alert event: enter the serial number of the intelligent alert event, such as 10001.

In the IoT Platform console, view all intelligent alert event types on the Feature Definition tab of the Product Details page. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.help_zh:
智能告警事件类型：
设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
设置为单个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，例如：10001。

请在物联网平台控制台，产品详情页面的功能定义页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying from in the returned results. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If the public instance does not have an ID value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
